State 01.recollectionDescription:
State Stats: Dexterity x Perception
Destroy your enemies with snake like weapon patterns. All shots now hit bosses multiple times with afterimages. Teleport to produce soul afterimages that do additional damage.

State 02.recollectionDescription:
State Stats: Strength x Vitality
Savagely devour bosses. Increased overall power is granted with this soul, The beast can also bite enemies by teleporting to recover some of its health.

State 03.recollectionDescription:
State Stats: Vitality x Essence
Powerful mech that provides the soul with additional protection and produces minions that massively increase power output.

State 04.recollectionDescription:
State Stats: Vitality x Dexterity
Soapy soul that purifies enemies with bubbled thoughts. These thoughts block enemy bullets and then shoot then contents.

State 06.recollectionDescription:
State Stats: Essence x Perception
Unload a storm of spikes onto your enemies. Spiked shots have extra pierce, and extra damage. Occasionally unload a 5 way burst for field-wide punishment.

State 07.recollectionDescription:
State Stats: Strength x Dexterity
Powerful knight that makes it's enemies bleed. Wield a powerful blade that can also shoot projectiles. Teleporting results in intricate swordplay that can redirect bullets.

State 09.recollectionDescription:
State Stats: Vitality x Perception
Create orbitals that shoot additional shots at enemies. You can also unload these orbitals onto your enemies for extra damage.

State 10.recollectionDescription:
State Stats: Essence x Perception
Charges up super powered shots directly from the core of its imagination. These shots come packed with static electricity that damages all surrounding foes.
